subject: Coordinated incentive & trial-extension for Orion Analytics - exec approval request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kate Sutton <kate@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial extension + credits proposal for ORN-8321

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, Orion's usage is trending in a way that will benefit from a longer hands-on period and a small, up-front credit to accelerate model tuning. To avoid the friction of re-architecting a new pilot, I'm proposing a coordinated package we can offer as an exception for ORN-8321: 

- 12-week trial extension (active sandbox access)
- $40,000 in platform credits applied to usage during the extension
- 18% committed-usage discount if Orion signs a 6-month paid commit within 45 days of PO

This package is designed to keep momentum for the technical evaluation while giving procurement something measurable to accept. I attached a one-page mutual action plan (ORN-8321-MAP.xlsx) that shows milestones and acceptance criteria.

If this needs exec sign-off I'm happy to summarize the ask and the commercial tradeoffs — main upside is higher likelihood of conversion and faster ramp to committed spend; downside is short-term revenue concession and creating a precedent (we'll flag both).

Would you be able to confirm this is sufficient to proceed on your side? If yes, I'll route for internal approval this morning.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0129

Ben —

Thanks, that looks sensible and addresses the team concerns. Procurement asked that any credits + discount package be approved by your leadership and finance (they need a signed variation for their PO). Also need a clear date by which the PO must be issued to lock the discount.

Can you escalate for the exec sign-off and come back with the exact contract language (we prefer a short amendment)? I can push internally once we have the variation and the DocuSign link.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Kate

Marissa / Evelyn —

Looping you in for a quick approval request. External ask (Orion Analytics, deal ORN-8321):

Proposal (exception):
- 12-week trial extension (sandbox environment continues)
- $40k promotional platform credits applied to the trial period
- 18% discount on usage for first 6 months if PO/commit executed within 45 days of variation signature

Why: product team needs more time to validate embeddings and lineage; prospect signals high likelihood to convert if we avoid re-procurement. Estimated incremental ARR if converted: $220k ARR in year 1.

Risks/controls:
- Precedent: flag as one-off tied to ORN-8321; require deal notes + tag in HubSpot.
- Billing: credits will be consumed against trial usage only; credits expire if no commit is signed by day 60 after extension end.
- Legal: will issue a short contract variation (attached draft: orn-contract-variation-v1.pdf) — needs Legal sign-off but we can attach as condition of approval.

Related links: HubSpot deal HS-48721 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/48721)

Request: Exec approval to offer this combined incentive. If approved please reply with any conditions. If not approved, any alternative thresholds (smaller credit, shorter extension) would be helpful.

Thanks — Ben
